Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.

If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

670-1619-5887-6150.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-5887-6150.description:
Cast Werefox Bodyguard by paying its mana cost.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Tomb of Horrors Adventurer until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, causing Tomb of Horrors Adventurer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Tomb of Horrors Adventurer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Werefox Bodyguard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Tomb of Horrors Adventurer until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Repeat from step 5.

1368-1879-6321-7763.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-1879-6321-7763.description:

Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.

3755-6791-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
3755-6791-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

277-1479-5700-5701-7705.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
277-1479-5700-5701-7705.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Mole Man trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Mole Man and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Mole Man triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1394-2060-5231-7038-7704.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Doc Samson.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Doc Samson.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

2511-6248-7084.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Phenomenon Investigators and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.

2557-5702-6202.notablePrerequisites: You have an instant or sorcery card in hand with mana to cast it.

Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.

Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.

Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
3293-5411-5721-6664.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

Resolve the Angelic Sell-Sword trigger, creating a token.

Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Maja triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {G}{W}{U}{B} and the remaining mana in any combination of color(s).

Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.

Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Cast World Shaper from your graveyard by paying {3}{G}.

Abhorrent Overlord enters the battlefield, creating a number of 1/1 Harpy creature tokens equal to your devotion to black.

If Staff of Domination is exiled, activate Myr Welder using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Otherwise, activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Myr Welder. Then, activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.

1168-1479-3147.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it, Toggo, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Toggo trigger.

Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}.
When you cast Sol Ring, Blisterspit Gremlin's last ability triggers, untapping it.
Sol Ring resolves.
Repeat from step 2.
